text: Builds from before `9433918` misorder suffixes starting at the last N of a run before the sequence delimiter under `--dna --allow-ambiguity` (`-a`): descending position with LCP 1. The N-run shortcut in `find_lcp` caused it. A byte comparison against such a build fails on any input with a run of N ending a record, hg38 among them. `b50991f` removed `-a`. The `n_ends` case in `table()` in `libsufr/tests/oracle.rs` pins the right order over the byte alphabet, which indexes N.
